verdict.rationale: The SDK writes sessions to disk automatically, and resuming a session restores full prior context. A SessionStore adapter can mirror transcripts to object, KV, or database backends, so a session created on one host can resume on another, which lets conversation state outlive a process restart or deploy. However, this is resume-from-transcript, not durable execution of in-flight runs, and the resuming host must have a matching working directory. missing for 10: evidence of durable-execution integrations (e.g. Temporal-style workflow engines), checkpointing and replay of in-flight tool calls across crashes, independent or hands-on corroboration of cross-deploy resume.
